product_metadata.title: BYKITCHEN Dish Separators Protectors, Gray Dinner Plate Divider Pads, China Storage Protectors for Protecting and Stacking Your Cookware, 30 Pieces & 2 Different Size
features: PROTECTOR PADS FOR COOKWARE - Perfect friction free protection when storing or moving your plates, porcelain, glassware, china dinnerware and more.
30 PIECES DISH DIVIDER PADS - Include 10pcs small separators pad: 5.9in/15cm, suitable for small saucer/ bread/ butter plates, and 20pcs large dish/ dinner plate separators pads: 9.8in/25cm.
PREMIUM FELT PLATE SEPARATORS - Made of soft white felt to prevent your plates,dishes or China from scratching and chipping, eco-friendly, durable and lightweight.
EASY TO USE - Just place plate protectors in between plates to avoid scratching and extend the life of your cookware.
STACKING PLATES/PANS/POTS PROTECTOR FOR SPACE SAVING: Great use for stacking your cookware, bowls, plates, dishes and more, a must-have to save space in your kitchen.
